acceptance.given: A Consumer Manifest transition omission or applicability exception is presented for evaluation.

oracle.expected: The Toolchain validation records an explicit pre-execution exception binding that identifies an existing authorized repository or ADR owner and binds that approval to the omitted Consumer transition; otherwise it rejects the omission.
forbidden: A Consumer transition is omitted without approval from an existing authorized repository or ADR owner.
An unbound, post-execution, or merely asserted exception is treated as valid.
The default transition requirement is treated as exempt before confirmation and binding.
oracle.observable: The Consumer-transition validation result identifies the omitted transition, its pre-bound authorized owner reference, and its acceptance or rejection decision.

acceptance.then: The omission is accepted only when the required authorized exception is already bound; otherwise the transition remains required and the evaluation rejects the omission.
acceptance.when: The Consumer Manifest is frozen or a Consumer transition omission or applicability exception is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Evaluate an omitted Consumer transition with no pre-bound approval from an existing authorized repository or ADR owner; require the Consumer-transition validation to reject the omission rather than treating it as an exemption.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the Toolchain Consumer-transition validator fail closed: an omission is legal only when a pre-execution, explicit exception binding names an existing authorized repository or ADR owner and binds that authority to the precise omitted Consumer transition. No default exemption, role-name assertion, or unbound exception is accepted.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validation-only Consumer-exception enforcement: retain existing Consumer route and receipt compatibility while removing only acceptance of an omission lacking a pre-bound authorized-owner exception.

slice_hint.state_transition: Consumer transition omission proposed -> authorized and transition-bound exception verified before execution, or omission rejected and transition remains applicable.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: For every evaluated Consumer-transition omission, the validation result accepts it only when its pre-execution binding identifies an existing authorized repository or ADR owner and the exact omitted transition; all absent, asserted-only, post-execution, or unbound exceptions produce rejection.
